entries.08c2ca9d4e3758a6: Pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas
entries.0a1749df1521a0bf: A company that, based on antibody technology originating from the University of Tokyo, conducts research and development of therapeutic antibody drugs for cancer and other diseases, antibody research support, and sales of research reagents.
entries.23271e9932e99c57: Antibody screening and production using VHH antibody libraries
entries.2dee7dcce79c8e52: Using hybridoma, phage display and single B cell screening methods, it obtains highly functional antibodies and advances their research and development as antibody drug candidates. Its development candidates include PPMX-T002, a radioisotope-labeled antibody targeting cadherin-3; PPMX-T003, which targets transferrin receptor 1; and PPMX-T004, an antibody-drug conjugate targeting cadherin-3, and it aims to secure contract upfront payments and milestone revenue through licensing to pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas. Revenue is not separately disclosed.
entries.45f4422d4a1225fb: Drawing on technologies and experience developed through creating antibody drugs and research reagents targeting cancer and other diseases, it provides antibody production, antibody gene sequence analysis and other research contract services to academia and pharmaceutical companies. In May 2025, it began offering antibody screening and production using VHH antibody libraries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥40 million.
entries.60eb443080cb9969: Researchers and research institutions in Japan and overseas
entries.64d1f37a9e89b083: Nuclear receptor antibodies (48 types in total)
entries.6f1da9538182bc9e: Pharmaceutical companies in Japan and overseas (licensees)
entries.8c70661d01235f9c: This is the company’s single segment. Based on protein expression and antibody production technologies developed at the Laboratory of Systems Biomedicine (LSBM), Research Center for Advanced Science and Technology, The University of Tokyo, it conducts research and development of antibody drugs and related operations in three fields: drug discovery, antibody research support, and antibody and reagent sales. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥135 million.
entries.edf60c24bf14820e: It carries a full lineup of 48 nuclear receptor antibodies serving as biomarkers and sells them as research reagents to researchers worldwide. It also sells other products, including the PTX3 ELISA kit and antibody reagents for antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) research. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥95 million.
